同花顺社区动态 · 9 items

Retail investor sentiment on Tonghuashun was mixed amid the market rout, with volume-driven chatter around a sharp drop in a trillion-yuan market cap stock and heavy turnover. Community discussions also tracked foreign fund flows, with Morgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs adjusting their positions. Key commodity price alerts included white-feathered broiler chicks and palm oil, while gold ETF holdings declined.

  • Trillion-yuan stock plunges: A major heavyweight saw heavy selling, becoming the highest-turnover stock on the A-share market, sparking intense discussion among retail investors (同花顺财经).
  • Foreign capital moves: Morgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs revealed their latest position adjustments, with community participants analyzing which stocks are being favored by foreign capital (同花顺财经).
  • Gold ETF holdings decline: SPDR Gold Trust holdings dropped by 6.27 tonnes, signaling reduced safe-haven demand despite geopolitical tensions (同花顺).
  • Commodity price alerts: The community flagged price changes in white-feathered broiler chick prices and palm oil, with traders watching for short-term volatility (同花顺财经 & 同花顺).
  • Shenzhen warns on real estate misinformation: Authorities flagged and penalized social media accounts posting false property market information (同花顺).

Bottom line: The community is hyper-focused on large-cap volatility and foreign positioning, with commodity price moves offering short-term trading cues, but overall sentiment remains cautious amid the broader selloff.

多频道新闻雷达 — 社会新闻

2026-06-26 · 窗口: 24h · 条目: 76 · 生成时间: 2026-06-26 05:39 UTC

板块速览

今日全球社会新闻呈现出多重危机与结构性变局。委内瑞拉遭遇双震级超7级浅源地震，已致至少235人死亡、4300人受伤，灾后救援在政治真空（前领导人马杜罗被美军抓捕不足半年）下举步维艰 (BBC)；美国最高法院裁定允许终止海地和叙利亚移民的临时保护身份（TPS），数十万长期居留者面临遣返风险 (BBC)；特朗普同时向国会施压要求拨款对伊朗战争，与共和党内部及北约盟友产生裂痕 (BBC)。东亚方面，日韩防长本周末将在首尔会晤，推动签署《获取与交叉服务协定》（ACSA），安全合作实质性升级 (Anadolu Ajansı)。中国社会层面，新华网发布关于青少年吸食“新型毒品”的调查，揭示隐秘危机 (新华网)；知乎2025年营收下滑23.6%，CEO周源宣布加速AI商业化转型 (财联社)。

后续观察： 委内瑞拉地震的国际救援响应与政治过渡能否同步，将是本周关键；美国TPS裁决可能引发大规模诉讼与人道危机；日韩防务合作升级或重塑东北亚安全格局；知乎的AI转型能否逆转营收颓势，值得关注其产品落地结果。

欧美 · 39 条

欧美板块今日焦点集中于三重叠加危机：委内瑞拉地震（7.2级与7.5级双震，致235死，4300伤）在政治真空下救援艰难，引发对国际援助效率的质疑 (BBC)；美国最高法院支持特朗普政府终止海地和叙利亚移民的临时保护身份（TPS），影响数十万人，人权组织称将导致“系统性的驱逐” (Al Jazeera)；特朗普与国会及北约的裂痕——要求数千亿美元对伊朗战争拨款遭共和党内部抵制，同时指责北约未提供支持 (NPR)。此外，欧洲热浪东移，巴黎限制酒精销售以减轻医院压力 (BBC)；法国50余名女性联名呼吁废除性侵诉讼时效 (BBC)。欧美当前处于“地缘冲突+气候变化+司法激变”的多重压力下，政策张力明显加剧。

日韩 · 13 条

日韩板块核心动向是安全合作升温：日本防卫大臣本周末访问首尔，与韩国国防部长会晤，拟签署《获取与交叉服务协定》（ACSA），实现后勤与弹药互供，被视为应对外部威胁的实质性突破 (每日新闻)。另外，日本北部发生7.2级地震，但暂无重大伤亡报告 (Japan Times)；日本男足在世界杯小组赛战平瑞典晋级16强，引发国内欢庆 (Japan Times)。此外，群马县一起女性被刺死案嫌犯在逃逸中车祸身亡，案件细节待披露 (Japan Times)。日韩安全合作加速，是对区域安全环境变化的直接回应，但国内社会事件（如地震、案件）仍提醒民众关注内政风险。

中国 · 18 条

中国社会新闻今日以政策宣传与主题报道为主，但有两则值得关注：一是新华网发布的《跌入蛛网的青春——部分青少年吸食“新型毒品”调查》，揭露了隐蔽毒品渗透校园的现状，具有高度现实警示意义 (新华网)；二是美敦力高管顾宇韶表态称“中国正成为医疗创新重要策源地”，反映跨国企业对华医疗市场战略定位的调整 (新华网)。其他如“富民厚生”、“伟大征程”、“六部门美丽中国建设”等均为常规意识形态宣传。股市方面，沪指半日跌2.14%，教育板块逆势走强 (中国经济网)。总体而言，官方叙事仍占主导，但民间关注点开始向毒品治理、留学租房、医疗创新等具体议题倾斜，说明舆论场正出现微观分化。

News Radar — 社会新闻

2026-06-26 · Window: 24h · Items: 76 · Generated: 2026-06-26 05:39 UTC

Editor's Brief

The past 24 hours have been dominated by dual seismic and geopolitical shocks. A devastating twin earthquake in Venezuela has killed at least 235, compounding the country's political uncertainty after the seizure of its former leader. Meanwhile, Trump's request for billions in war funding for Iran is setting up a bitter clash with his own party, and the Supreme Court has cleared the way to end protections for hundreds of thousands of Haitian and Syrian immigrants. In Asia, Japan and South Korea are moving to deepen defense ties, while a separate 7.2-magnitude quake struck northern Japan. China's state media focuses on ideological education, but a rare investigative report on youth drug abuse signals growing social concern.

  • Venezuela earthquakes kill at least 235, thousands injured — Two shallow 7+ magnitude quakes seconds apart, with 4,300 injured and buildings collapsing in Caracas.
  • Trump asks Congress for billions for Iran war, facing Republican resistance — The budget faces an uphill battle as the president spars with members of his own party.
  • Supreme Court allows Trump to end TPS for Haitians and Syrians — Ruling opens path to deport hundreds of thousands who have lived in the US for years.
  • Israel’s cycle of conflict shows no finish line — Despite ceasefires, wars continue with no lasting security gains.
  • Paris restricts alcohol as Europe heatwave shifts east — Temperatures in Germany could hit 40°C; alcohol rules aim to ease hospital pressure.
  • Japan advances to World Cup knockout stage after draw with Sweden — A moment of national pride amid broader regional tensions.
  • Chinese media report on youth 'new-type drug' abuse — A rare investigative deep dive into rising synthetic drug use among adolescents.

Watch next: The Venezuela humanitarian crisis will deepen as rescue efforts continue. Watch for the Trump-NATO friction ahead of any Iran war vote, and the fallout from the TPS ruling for immigrant communities. The Japan-South Korea defense talks this weekend could reshape regional security postures.

欧美 · 39 items

The Western hemisphere is reeling from a major earthquake disaster and sharpening political confrontations. The 7.2 and 7.5 magnitude quakes in Venezuela have killed at least 235 and injured over 4,300, hitting a country already in crisis after the US seizure of former leader Maduro. In the US, President Trump is demanding billions for a war with Iran, but faces pushback from his own party, and the Supreme Court has cleared termination of Temporary Protected Status for Haitians and Syrians. Europe is battling a severe heatwave, with Paris restricting alcohol sales. Meanwhile, Israel's ongoing conflicts show no end, and women in France are calling for abolition of rape statute of limitations.

  • Venezuela quake: rescues ongoing as death toll rises — 235 dead, 4,300 injured; buildings collapse in Caracas; quakes come months after Maduro's seizure.
  • Trump's Iran war budget faces Republican skepticism — The president airs grievances with NATO chief over lack of allied support.
  • Supreme Court sides with Trump on ending TPS for Haitians and Syrians — Hundreds of thousands face deportation after years in the US.
  • Israel's 'forever wars' continue without clear end — Analysis finds no lasting security gains despite ceasefires.
  • Paris restricts alcohol as heatwave moves east — Temperatures near 40°C in Germany; alcohol rules to reduce hospital strain.

The coming days will test whether the Trump administration can secure war funding and manage the domestic fallout from mass deportations, while Venezuela faces a humanitarian catastrophe.

日韩 · 13 items

Northeast Asian security cooperation is deepening as Japan's defense minister prepares to visit Seoul this weekend for talks with his South Korean counterpart, focusing on expanded military ties and possibly a new Acquisition and Cross-Servicing Agreement. Concurrently, a 7.2 magnitude earthquake struck northern Japan (Hokkaido region), though no major casualties have been reported yet. Japan's national mood was lifted by the national soccer team advancing to the World Cup knockout stage. Markets in Asia fell sharply as traders booked profits from the AI-driven rally, with a 2.14% drop in Shanghai's composite index also noted.

  • Japan, South Korea defense chiefs to meet in Seoul — Talks this weekend on expanded security cooperation, possibly including logistics agreements.
  • Magnitude 7.2 quake hits northern Japan — Shallow quake; no immediate reports of major damage but aftershocks expected.
  • Japan advances to World Cup knockout stage — Draw with Sweden secures place; national celebration amidst broader news.
  • Asian shares plunge as AI rally profits taken — Markets sell off after recent AI-driven gains; caution ahead.

With defense talks and a fresh earthquake, the region's attention will be split between diplomatic signals and disaster preparedness.

中国 · 18 items

China's official media continues a heavy focus on ideological education and party history, with multiple outlets running 'Great Journey' series and calls to strengthen socialist core values. However, a notable investigative report from Xinhua reveals a growing problem of 'new-type drugs' among adolescents, providing rare social criticism. The Shanghai composite index fell 2.14% in morning trading, in line with broader Asian market declines. On the business front, Medtronic's Asia head praised China as a rising source of medical innovation.

  • Youth drug abuse investigation: 'Fall into spider web' — Xinhua reports on rising synthetic drug use among young people, a sensitive topic.
  • Shanghai index drops 2.14% amid global sell-off — Education sector bucked the trend with gains amid broader weakness.
  • Medtronic executive: China becoming medical innovation hub — Positive foreign investment signal amid challenging economic environment.
  • Six departments issue plan for 'Beautiful China' action — Environmental campaign aimed at mass participation, likely tied to propaganda goals.

The gap between official narratives and real social issues remains stark; the drug survey suggests authorities are willing to acknowledge certain problems even as they double down on ideological messaging.

item.content:encoded:
多频道新闻雷达 — 军事新闻

2026-06-26 · 窗口: 24h · 条目: 63 · 生成时间: 2026-06-26 05:39 UTC

板块速览

今日军事新闻呈现三大主线：朝鲜首次列装“崔贤”级导弹驱逐舰并宣布建造万吨巡洋舰，正式迈入海军核武装化阶段；美国空军提出1000海里远程导弹计划，矛头直指中国反介入/区域拒止体系；伊朗战争持续冲击霍尔木兹海峡航运，全球能源通道面临威胁。此外，菲律宾部署美制无人侦察机、乌克兰无人机技术反导化、中美科技企业清单博弈等亦值得关注。

  • 朝鲜海军核化加速：6月23日，朝鲜正式列装首艘5000吨级“崔贤”级导弹驱逐舰，并宣布后续万吨巡洋舰计划，金正恩明确将推进海军核武装（quwa.org）。此举将加剧半岛军备竞赛，并促使韩日强化反导与打击能力。
  • 美空军远程导弹革命：美空军发布“远程武器”项目，寻求空对空/空对地射程均超1000海里的下一代导弹，以应对中国海空力量（Air & Space Forces Magazine）。同时，美国批准向澳大利亚出口AIM-260，强化盟友空战能力（19FortyFive）。
  • 霍尔木兹海峡航运承压：伊朗袭击商船后，原定通过海峡的船舶计划暂停，航运恢复进程受阻（The War Zone）。战争对全球能源安全的影响日益显著。
  • 菲律宾南海部署无人机：菲律宾将美制“特里同”无人侦察机部署至西部海域，监视中国在黄岩岛设置的浮台（Defense News）。南海无人化对峙升级。
  • 乌克兰无人机反导化：乌克兰最大攻击无人机制造商Fire Point与德国Hensoldt合作生产“弗蕾亚”反导系统，将攻击无人机技术转向导弹防御（Defense News）。
  • 白俄准备扩大参战：大西洋理事会分析称，白俄罗斯正秘密准备更深度介入俄乌战争（Atlantic Council）。
  • 阿里巴巴起诉美国防部：阿里巴巴正式起诉美国国防部，要求从“中国军事企业清单”中移除（白鲸出海）；商务部回应将采取反制措施（新浪财经）。

后续观察：朝鲜海军核武装化将引发东北亚新一轮军备竞赛，美日韩需调整威慑态势；美国远程导弹计划若落地，将根本改变空战与反介入博弈规则；伊朗战争对全球航运和能源价格的冲击仍在发酵，需密切关注霍尔木兹海峡通航状况及美军反应。

国际安全 · 34 条

今日国际安全领域多重信号同时释放：朝鲜首次列装“崔贤”级驱逐舰并宣布建造万吨巡洋舰，金正恩明确海军核武装化方向（quwa.org）；美国空军发布1000海里远程导弹需求，意在对抗中国“反介入/区域拒止”能力（Air & Space Forces Magazine）；霍尔木兹海峡在伊朗袭击商船后暂停船舶调度，能源通道安全面临直接威胁（The War Zone）。此外，美国批准向土耳其出口F110发动机供KAAN战斗机使用，可能为F-35回归铺路（The War Zone）。

item.content:encoded:
News Radar — 军事新闻

2026-06-26 · Window: 24h · Items: 63 · Generated: 2026-06-26 05:39 UTC

Editor's Brief

The past 24 hours have seen a flurry of strategic signalling and capability developments across multiple theaters. North Korea's commissioning of its first guided-missile destroyer and Kim Jong Un's call for a 'destructive' posture mark a significant escalation in naval nuclearisation. The U.S. Air Force has announced plans for a new 1,000-nautical-mile stand-off missile family, signaling a major shift in long-range precision strike to counter peer adversaries. Meanwhile, the Iran war continues to reshape energy security and naval traffic in the Strait of Hormuz, and Ukraine is innovating with drone-based ballistic missile defense and balloon-launched strike weapons. China is pushing back against U.S. sanctions lists and Japanese criticism of its defense spending, while the Philippines deploys U.S.-made naval drones in the South China Sea. The RIMPAC 2026 exercise kicks off in Hawaii, and a fire aboard USS Indianapolis underscores naval readiness concerns.

  • North Korea commissions its 5,000-ton Choe Hyon-class destroyer and outlines plans for a 10,000-ton cruiser, with Kim linking the move to naval nuclearisation (quwa.org | ABC News).
  • The U.S. Air Force is soliciting a new family of long-range missiles with a 1,000-nautical-mile range for both air-to-air and air-to-surface missions, explicitly to counter Chinese forces in a potential conflict (USNI News | Air & Space Forces Magazine).
  • Iran's strike on a cargo vessel has paused a plan to move ships through the Strait of Hormuz, highlighting ongoing risks to global energy shipping (The War Zone).
  • Ukraine's top drone maker Fire Point is partnering with Germany's Hensoldt to build a ballistic missile defense system, while Kyiv fields new wind-drift balloons that bait Russian air defenses and launch missiles (Defense News | Defense News).
  • China's Ministry of Commerce vows countermeasures after the U.S. adds firms to its 'Chinese military enterprise list'; Alibaba has formally sued the Pentagon to be removed (新浪财经 | 电子工程专辑).
  • The Philippines has deployed U.S.-made Triton naval drones in its western waters to monitor intrusions, following China's discreet installation of a floating platform at Scarborough Shoal (Defense News).
  • RIMPAC 2026 has begun in Hawaii with 31 surface ships, 5 submarines, 197 aircraft, and 30,000 personnel from multiple nations (USNI News).
  • A fire aboard the Littoral Combat Ship USS Indianapolis at Mayport injured seven sailors, all treated and released (USNI News).

Watch next: The intersection of North Korea's naval nuclearisation and U.S. long-range missile plans will dominate strategic discussion. Monitor Iran's next moves in the Strait of Hormuz and whether China escalates its legal and diplomatic response to U.S. military lists. RIMPAC 2026 may reveal new coalition dynamics.

国际安全 · 34 items

Global security headlines are dominated by two parallel trends: North Korea's aggressive naval modernisation linked to tactical nuclear weapons, and a rapid U.S. push for extreme-range stand-off missiles designed for a potential conflict with China. Meanwhile, the Iran war continues to disrupt maritime traffic in the Strait of Hormuz, and Ukraine is fielding novel drone and balloon systems that are reshaping the air defense battlefield.

  • North Korea commissioned its first Choe Hyon-class guided-missile destroyer (5,000 tons) and announced plans for a 10,000-ton cruiser. Kim Jong Un explicitly tied this to naval nuclearisation, calling for a 'destructive' military posture as South Korea responds with drone reinforcements (quwa.org | ABC News).
  • The U.S. Air Force is seeking a next-generation stand-off missile with a 1,000-nautical-mile range for both air-to-air and air-to-surface roles, explicitly to counter Chinese air and naval forces. The move leapfrogs existing AMRAAM and JASSM capabilities (Air & Space Forces Magazine | USNI News).
  • Iran struck a cargo vessel, causing a pause in convoy plans through the Strait of Hormuz. This follows a period of resumed shipping, highlighting the fragility of energy transit in the region (The War Zone).
  • Ukraine's Fire Point, the top strike-drone maker, is partnering with Germany's Hensoldt to build a homegrown ballistic missile defense system called Freyja. Separately, Ukraine is using wind-carried balloons to bait Russian air defenses and launch missiles — a tactic also adopted by the U.S. and Russia (Defense News | Defense News).
  • The White House is proposing to raid Navy E-2 Hawkeye funds to pay for USAF E-7 Wedgetail aircraft, an ironic reversal of earlier Pentagon plans to cancel the E-7 (The War Zone).

Signal: North Korea's naval nuclearisation and the U.S. missile range race are creating a new axis of strategic competition; the Iran situation remains a wildcard for global energy markets.

冲突局势 · 12 items

The evolving conflict landscape shows Europe grappling with NATO dependency versus autonomy ambitions, while the war in Iran is producing second-order effects on great power dynamics and energy security. Belarus is quietly preparing a larger role in Russia's Ukraine war, and Ukraine's battlefield innovations are outpacing NATO's formal development processes.

  • A Eurasia Review analysis warns that Europe remains trapped between ambitions for strategic autonomy and deep dependence on U.S. security guarantees, a tension amplified by the Iran war and the Ukraine conflict (Eurasia Review).
  • The Soufan Center examines the great power implications of the war in Iran, noting how it reshapes alliances and arms flows beyond the immediate theater (The Soufan Center).
  • Belarus is quietly preparing to increase its military role in Russia's war against Ukraine, with potential implications for NATO's eastern flank (Atlantic Council).
  • A Ukrainian commander expressed unease about NATO's approach to developing naval drones, suggesting a mismatch between alliance processes and real combat requirements in the Black Sea (Business Insider).
  • News analysis argues that the U.S. war in Iran inadvertently gave Tehran a new superweapon, referring to the strategic consequences of military failure in the missile duel (Derek Thompson | Substack).

Signal: The Ukraine conflict continues to drive asymmetric innovation and expose NATO's structural inertia, while Belarus's deepening involvement could open a new front.

中国军情 · 10 items

China is pushing back on multiple fronts: legal action against U.S. sanctions, diplomatic rebuttals to Japanese criticism, and symbolic demonstrations of sovereignty in the South China Sea. The Ministry of Commerce has vowed countermeasures after the U.S. expanded its 'Chinese military enterprise list,' and Alibaba has formally sued the Pentagon to be removed from that list.

  • Alibaba has filed a lawsuit against the U.S. Department of Defense, demanding removal from the 'Chinese military enterprise list' (白鲸出海 | 电子工程专辑).
  • The Ministry of Commerce stated that China has to take countermeasures in response to the U.S. addition of firms to the 'Chinese military enterprise list' (新浪财经).
  • The Chinese Ministry of National Defense accused Japan of using 'conspiracy theories' to smear China's defense spending and cover up Japan's own remilitarization (香港電台 | 新浪军事).
  • A blue hole discovery in the South China Sea is being used by Chinese state media to highlight scientific research and demonstrate China's ability to safeguard its maritime rights (中华网).

Signal: China is hardening its legal and rhetorical stance against U.S. designation of military-linked firms, while reinforcing its territorial claims in the South China Sea through both hard and soft power.
